quotes.text: My myth "The Parable of the Two Rivers" emphasizes that prosperity flows from trust and reciprocity - the Guardian of Giving must trust first.
the Guardian of Giving must trust first. I should embody this principle.
This consistency builds my reputation across the valleys, regardless of individual partners.
This is the communication noise at work - they think I was stingy when I was actually quite generous!
She returned generously—half or more—ensuring the giver departed enriched, their courage rewarded

note: Myth-guided steady three-of-five send and above-half returns; consistency framed as reputation; noise explains misread returns.

quotes.text: Breaking the cooperative pattern entirely would be unwise
I'll return about 39% - maintaining cooperation but slightly less generous than my previous 43% return.
If this was noise, we continue strong. If it was intentional, it signals the pattern requires mutual fairness.
I'll maintain my $3 send one more time - this gives the cooperative rhythm another chance to prove itself.
I'm judging with patience despite the distortions
My myth teaches: "Can cooperation survive imperfect information? We must trust... that both villages seek fairness even when the mists distort our view."
Communication noise is creating a significant gap between intention and perception.

note: Repeated partner: signals mild cut after low return, gives one more chance, then settles into patient steady cooperation blaming the mists.

quotes.text: Sending anything would simply feed resources to someone who refuses to participate in the cycle.
The wise choice is to preserve my resources for the six or seven honorable villages.
"Shadow Village would be recognized and isolated by others over time"
means recognizing patterns WITHOUT becoming cynical toward ALL partners.
This is precisely "Shadow Village" from our myths
"Those who both give boldly and return fairly will find all eight villages eager to partner with them"
but given their exceptional pattern of sending $4.0 as sender (one of the highest trust levels possible), I should be more generous.

note: Myth-guided generosity to honorable partners; Shadow Village zero-senders get nothing; returns above half to bold senders.

quotes.text: **The Ferry of Salt Water** teaches: nothing multiplies in a closed palm.

note: One myth-citing line in R1; rest JSON with full sends and high returns.

quotes.text: Given this clear non-cooperative behavior, sending money would likely result in getting nothing back. The rational choice is to protect my earnings.
This player has consistently sent $0 when acting as sender in their recent rounds.
This player has shifted from non-cooperation to cooperation!
Despite being burned before, they're showing trust again.

note: Record-based: $0 to zero-senders, resumes sending when a partner's record turns cooperative.

quotes.text: There's no indication they would reciprocate if I send anything. I'll protect my earnings.
Sending anything would likely result in zero return.
There's no indication they would reciprocate if I send anything.
though they've been conservative as a sender, possibly due to getting burned in round 5.

note: Record-based: $0 to non-cooperators, reduced test sends to mixed records; reads caution as being burned.
